```typescript title="TypeScript"

  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  const result = await client.ocr({ document: { type: "document_url", url: "https://example.com/multipage.pdf" }, model: "mistral/mistral-ocr-latest" });
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
